items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Okay I did two records with Rahsaan. The one “I Talk with the Spirits,” you may have run across that where it’s “Serenade to a Cuckoo” — that’s me.

ctx.x: Can you describe for me what let’s say the late 60s, if you were doing a record date with Rahsaan or anybody else, what exactly, how much time you got in the studio and what was the pressure like. Was there pressure?

Okay. Okay I did two records with Rahsaan. The one “I Talk with the Spirits,” you may have run across that where it’s “Serenade to a Cuckoo” — that’s me. Okay? For me — and that was my second record. My first record I made with him they didn’t put my name on the record jacket. So that was traumatic.
What was the name of the record?
